# GitFlix v6.0 — AI Agent Marketplace on Solana
> The world's first AI Agent Marketplace with Brains. Buy, sell, and create AI agents as NFTs on Solana.

## What is GitFlix?
GitFlix is the world's first AI Agent Marketplace combining NFT ownership with functional AI agents.
Browse 420M+ GitHub repos visually, collect 12 MCP-powered AI agents on Solana, create and sell your own
agents using the .agent.md interoperability standard. Cross-platform compatible with Claude, OpenAI, Grok, and Gemini.

## Key Features
- AI Agent Marketplace: 12 unique agents with soul, memory, MCP tools, and .agent.md files
- Create Agent: Build and list your AI agent on the marketplace, earn 85% of sales
- .agent.md Standard: Universal AI agent interoperability format for all major LLM providers
- Solana NFT: Agents are NFTs on Solana (Metaplex Core), tradeable on MagicEden
- Claude Buddies: 18 free AI assistant species (no blockchain required)
- Phantom Wallet: Native Solana wallet connection
- Anonymous Listings: Privacy-first agent trading, no surveillance
- Netflix-style GitHub repo browser with 10 categories
- i18n: 14 languages, auto-detect
- Pro tier ($9.99 lifetime) for unlimited repo views

## Tech Stack
- React 19, TypeScript 5.8, Vite 6.4
- Solana (Phantom wallet, Metaplex Core NFTs)
- GitHub REST API
- Deployed on GitHub Pages (free)

## AI Agent Interoperability
- .agent.md: Universal agent config format
- Compatible with: Claude Code (CLAUDE.md), OpenAI Codex (AGENTS.md), Grok, Gemini
- MCP Servers: claw-mcp-toolkit, grok-search, x-mcp, crypto-prices, sequential-thinking
- On-chain ownership via Solana NFT (Metaplex Core)
